task.description: Test design validation for REQ-057 questionnaire page (card + questionnaire), steps 08 and 13. Independently check with your own reading and runs: (1) every acceptance criterion of REQ-057 in docs/requirements.yaml has a real runnable test (use the table in docs/design/REQ-057-picker-page.md sections 16-17; check the table against the files yourself, not the other way); (2) no skipped coverage, no todo, no test without assertions, no assertion that cannot fail; (3) independence: the oracles in tools/test/picker-page*.test.js are not copies of the code under test, tests are isolated and order independent (run the three files alone and in reversed file order on a copy), fixtures self-sufficient, no clock or timers; (4) apply YOURSELF a sample of at least 15 mutants of section 20 of the design document, chosen by you across all areas (answers, rules, flow, store, net limits, language race, rendering, accessibility attributes), and at least 5 NEW mutants you invent that are not in section 20, on copies outside the project in the scratchpad; report which survive and why; (5) the replaced stubs LG-10c, SF-6c, SU-10, SU-11, SV-1f, SV-7e, TR-4b, TR-4e: the replacement is not weaker than the original (compare with the base tag). The computer has 16 GB RAM: run single test files and mutants one at a time; run the full npm run check at most once. Report PASS or FAIL with numbers.

findings.place: tools/test/picker-page.test.js:906 (QP-4b) and :2192 (QP-9f); code tools/src/picker/public/app.js:184, :185, :564, :565 (the hadAny conditions)
findings.what: The notice 'the questionnaire changed' is pinned only for one combined stored state (answers present AND position not first). Survivors N5 (clause 'answers present' of hadAny on load removed), N5c (clause 'position not first' on load removed), N5b and N5d (the same two clauses in newVersion, the change of language) pass all 99 tests. Probes (copy only): another version + answers {business} + current 'business' (the first question) must show the notice; another version + no answers + current 'items' must show the notice; both pass on the real code and fail on N5 and N5c. Design 5.2 B1 states hadAny = answers present OR position not first.
findings.fix: TEST-DESIGNER: in QP-4b add the two single-clause cases (answers only with position first; position only with no answers) and check notice, cleared value and kept lang; in QP-9f add the same two cases for the change of language where reachable (answers present with the position on the first question), so N5b and N5d die.

findings.place: tools/test/picker-page.test.js:433 (QP-2d), :881 (QP-4a); code app.js:363 (Back), :405 (Next), :462 (Back from the result screen)
findings.what: No test pins that a move without a new answer writes the position. Survivors N3 (Back does not save), N37 (Next does not save), N35 (Back from the result does not save) pass all 99 tests; N36 (Continue does not save) is killed only by QP-4f. Design 5.2 rows Q2, Q3, Q5, E1 say the storage 'пишет' on the move; criterion 4 acceptance step is 'go half way, reload, the same question'. Probe: answer question 1, Next, then reload and press Continue should open 'Вопрос 2'; passes on the real code and fails on N37 (the page would reopen question 1).
findings.fix: TEST-DESIGNER: in QP-2d and QP-4a (or one new test) after Next, after Back and after Back from the result screen with no answer given, assert page.stored(UP).current is the new question and that a new load plus Continue opens it (and the write log shows the setItem).

findings.what: The order-of-answers race is pinned for the questionnaire request (QP-9e, M65 killed) but not for the second await of a language change on the result screen. Survivor G2 (the ticket check removed from 'if (ticket !== state.ticket || state.screen !== "result") return;') passes all 99 tests. Probe: on the result screen press kk, then en; answer the POST of en first and the POST of kk last; the page must stay on en (lang, aria-current, address ?lang=en); passes on the real code, fails on G2 (expected 'en', actual 'kk'). Rule L1 says the last press wins.
findings.fix: TEST-DESIGNER: add to QP-9h (or QP-9e) the case 'result screen, two presses, the re-POST answers in the reversed order' for both orders, and assert lang, aria-current, address, storage lang, and the shown result language.

findings.what: Survivor N4 (Skip does not clear the field) passes all tests. The field is rebuilt on every move, so the difference shows only when 'Skip' on the last question is followed by a failed request: the old answer would stay visibly chosen while the state and the request hold none.
findings.fix: TEST-DESIGNER: in QP-2e after Skip on the last optional question with the net refused, assert that no option is checked / the number field is empty and that 'Try again' sends the body without that answer.

findings.what: The design says M29 (verdict lets an invalid number of an optional question pass) is killed by QP-2g and M24 (bodyAnswers keeps hidden) by QM-1d/QP-2e. In my runs M29 is killed only by QM-2d and M24 only by QM-2e. QP-2g checks the optional number with '11' (a number outside the range), not with a text that is not a number ('abc'/badInput), so the integration level misses that branch.
findings.fix: Optional: add 'abc' to the optional case of QP-2g; correct the 'Убит' column of section 20 for M24 and M29.

findings.place: app.js:414 (send(): openQuestion guard), app.js:424 (sent = bodyAnswers(...)), net.js:130 (languages.length > 3)
